evidence: Modifies core block-index and chain management data structures in src/chain.h and src/chain.cpp, including CChain internal storage.
rationale: Refactors CChain and block index signatures to take CBlockIndex by reference instead of raw pointers to enforce non-null invariants at compile time. Author characterizes the change as a "slight improvement in code quality, maintainability and robustness" with no impact on consensus, chainstate performance, or runtime validation behavior.
